caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench with a high back and armrests, shown from the front against a plain, off-white background. The bench is made of light brown wood with visible grain and texture, giving the surface a natural appearance. The backrest features a row of vertical, decorative slats with notched edges, held between a flat, horizontal top rail with a scalloped upper edge and a lower rail. The seat of the bench is flat and slightly wider than the backrest, while the skirt and front legs continue the design motif with matching vertical slats and square feet. Both armrests are straight and horizontal, attached at right angles to the sides of the bench. The entire bench has a symmetrical and geometric composition, and the drawing style carefully details the wood joints, coloring, and texture, highlighting the individual wooden elements and their assembly. There are some tan and yellowish marks at the top of the background, suggesting possible aging or stains on the paper.
title: Bench
